title: À la recherche de Gabriel  (Looking for Gabriel)

segments.t: Following her successful audition, Sofia arrives late at the nearly empty agency party. Looking around the quiet room, she urgently asks Camille where Gabriel has gone. Let's listen to the scene in French first.
Camille, as-tu vu Gabriel ici?
Bonsoir Sofia, tu arrives bien tard.
Je cherchais Gabriel dans l'agence.
La fête est presque terminée maintenant.
Je voulais lui parler ce soir.
Tu as fini ton travail aujourd'hui?
Oui, mon audition s'est bien passée.
C'est une excellente nouvelle pour toi.
Je voulais fêter cela avec lui.
Tout le monde est déjà parti.
Il n'est plus dans son bureau?
Non, son bureau est tout noir.
Alors, où est-il allé maintenant?
Attends, je vais tout te raconter.
Let's examine how Sofia arrives hoping to see Gabriel step by step.
Camille, as-tu vu Gabriel ici?
'Camille, did you see Gabriel here?' Sofia searches the room and asks about Gabriel.
Bonsoir Sofia, tu arrives bien tard.
'Good evening Sofia, you arrive quite late.' Camille notices that Sofia came after the rush.
Je cherchais Gabriel dans l'agence.
'I was looking for Gabriel in the agency.' Sofia explains her reason for dropping by.
La fête est presque terminée maintenant.
'The party is almost over now.' Camille points to the emptying office.
Je voulais lui parler ce soir.
'I wanted to speak to him tonight.' Sofia shares her desire to reconnect with Gabriel.
Tu as fini ton travail aujourd'hui?
'Did you finish your work today?' Camille asks about her busy schedule.
Oui, mon audition s'est bien passée.
'Yes, my audition went very well.' Sofia mentions that her successful performance.
C'est une excellente nouvelle pour toi.
'That is excellent news for you.' Camille offers sincere congratulations.
Je voulais fêter cela avec lui.
'I wanted to celebrate that with him.' Sofia confesses her hope to celebrate together.
Tout le monde est déjà parti.
'Everyone has already left.' Camille gently prepares her for disappointment.
Il n'est plus dans son bureau?
'He is no longer in his office?' Sofia wonders if he might still be upstairs.
Non, son bureau est tout noir.
'No, his office is completely dark.' Camille confirms that his room is shut down.
Alors, où est-il allé maintenant?
'So, where did he go now?' Sofia asks anxiously about his current location.
Attends, je vais tout te raconter.
'Wait, I will tell you everything.' Camille pauses before sharing the difficult truth. Now listen to the whole scene again at normal speed, and see how much more you catch.

Bonsoir Sofia, tu arrives bien tard.

Je voulais fêter cela avec lui.

Il n'est plus dans son bureau?
Non, son bureau est tout noir.
Alors, où est-il allé maintenant?
Attends, je vais tout te raconter.

Hoping to share the triumph of her casting audition with Gabriel, Sofia searches the deserted agency floor and presses Camille for news of his whereabouts. When you watch the episode, listen out for the expressions meaning 'seen' and 'arrive'. You'll catch them now. See you next time!
À bientôt!
